# SyMoNsAyLeaRn

> An inference runtime you run on your own hardware: one GPU, one host, three loopback ports, a public wire dialect (the Messages dialect) on the front. Proprietary, source-available (FSL-1.1-ALv2; Apache-2.0 two years after each release). Licensor SymonSaysLLC.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](docs/getting_started.md): install from a verified release or from source; first request; what must exist before the chat unit answers
- [HTTP API](docs/http_api.md): every route of the Messages dialect as served here, credential, error envelope, model rows and the family-tier field, streaming events
- [Command line](docs/cli.md): symoneural-gateway, the bring-up ladder, the image launcher, ship gate, release cutter, installer, benchmark, licence audit

- [Monitoring](docs/monitoring.md): /health, /ready, /version, request ids, rack view, logs
- [Performance](docs/performance.md): measured numbers on the reference host and how they were taken
- [Security](docs/security.md): credential model, loopback by design, what never enters a repository, the ship gate
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): traps already paid for — symptom, cause, fix

## Wire contract

- Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:9001 (loopback; public reach is the operator's edge proxy)
- Credential: `x-api-key: <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; the key lives in the file SYM_GW_KEY_FILE names
- Routes: GET /health (public), GET /ready, GET /version, GET /v1/models, GET /v1/models/{id}, POST /v1/messages (stream: true for server-sent events), POST /v1/messages/count_tokens
- Models: symon-chat (tier sonnet), symon-coder (tier opus), symon-work (tier fable); each row carries the family-tier field
- Errors: {"type":"error","error":{"type":"...","message":"..."}} with the dialect's type strings
